plain: The mixing angles are still not derived. But with charged leptons diagonal, one small angle (theta13), a three-way choice among the lane's own symmetry flips (data now favour a flip the lane never tried, giving solar 0.318, atmospheric 0.5, CP phase -90 degrees) and a sign fix all the rest. The three 'incompatible routes' are rival models, and the lane's TM2 package has an error: a Klein-symmetric operator forces theta13 = 0.
best_route: R1: neutrino operator keeps the third Klein flip S.P23 (TM1) plus the mu-tau reflection; first artifact is the TM1 magnitudes lemma and the operator runner (A_v4_branches.py), wounded because the flip is chosen by data and theta13 stays free.
test: Random Hermitian operators per flip (20,000 each): TM2 s12^2 in [0.3404,0.3416] (never in the NuFIT-6.1 3-sigma box), TM1 s12^2 in [0.3168,0.3192] inside it with s23^2=0.5, |sin delta|=1; V4 commutant forces theta13=0; chart baseline branch has s23^2>=0.5351; finite-group catalogue (S3, O_h) never reaches the box (smallest nonzero |U_e3|^2 = 0.0447).
price: One dimensionless C3-doublet-breaking angle (theta13), plus a state selection among three Klein flips and a sign (realized_state_primitive: registered data), plus shared premises U_e = I, electron = fixed corner, sigma_hier, mu-tau reflection, species identification.
